name: Ribozyme
oneLine: An RNA that works like a tool. This one cuts other RNA.
howItWorks: The hammerhead ribozyme folds into a three-armed shape. It grabs a target strand by matching letters. Then it bends the backbone until it snaps.
deeper: Thomas Cech and Sidney Altman won the 1989 Nobel Prize for finding RNA that speeds up reactions. The hammerhead is found in plants, animals and viruses.
sizeComparison: a 20,000th the width of a hair
simplification: The cut happens in slow motion. Real cuts take a fraction of a second.
